logs.title: YOU ARE NOT USING SOCIAL MEDIA, SOCIAL MEDIA IS USING YOU
logs.content:
Look closely at this picture. It reveals a truth that millions of people are walking through every single day without even realizing it: many have quietly become slaves to the very things they think they own. 

When you buy a tool, its only purpose is to serve you. You pick it up with intent, use it to complete a task, and set it down when you are finished. But the moment that tool starts dictating when you wake up, where your attention goes, and how you feel, it is no longer a tool. It has become your master, and you have become its slave.

This isn't just about social media or phones. It is a direct lesson about real life. Look around and you will see people being pulled along on a leash by their mindless routines, their need for constant validation, and the overwhelming noise of external demands. They think they are choosing their path, but they are simply reacting to what controls them.

Stop living on autopilot. Recognize that your focus, your time, and your mind are your most valuable assets. Do not allow your habits or your devices to command your life. Take back the leash, step back into authority, and make sure that you remain the absolute master of your own journey every single day.
